# Clam basket presentation crops

These unaltered 97×93 pixel crops are from the 1920×1080 Japanese Clam Blitz
recording `2026-09-05 09-34-24.mov`, at the indicated video seconds, using
pixel box `(912, 122, 1009, 215)`. The recording is identified as Clam Blitz
in `analysis/clam_blitz_score_survey/runs.json`.

Manual visual review of sequences 75–98, 205–222, and 295–305 seconds found
purple or green colored discs, thin/disappearing colored wedges, the white
center icon, and map overlays. Tests label these as provisional open cue or
unknown; the white icon is not yet an independently validated closed classifier.
These correlated crops from one match are regression fixtures, not an
independent accuracy dataset.
